name: O1
description: Haplogroup O1 is the defining paternal lineage of the Austronesian expansion, one of the most geographically sweeping demographic events in human prehistory. O1 — specifically its subclade O1a — originated among the proto-Austronesian populations of Taiwan and the southern Chinese coast and spread across Southeast Asia, Maritime Southeast Asia, Madagascar, and the Pacific Islands as Austronesian seafarers colonised the ocean over the past 5,000 years. O1b is concentrated in mainland Southeast Asian populations including the Vietnamese, Thai, and Mon-Khmer peoples. Together, O1 lineages are found at high frequencies among Taiwanese Aborigines (up to 90%), Polynesians (~70%), and various Southeast Asian groups.
interestingFact: Haplogroup O1a is carried by the vast majority of Polynesian men, tracing every male lineage in populations from Hawaii to New Zealand to Easter Island back to the Austronesian seafarers who launched from Taiwan approximately 5,000 years ago — one of the most extraordinary colonisation events in human history.

clans.name: Austronesian peoples
clans.note: O1a is the defining lineage of the Austronesian expansion from Taiwan into the Pacific over the past 5,000 years
